title: Mobile (smartphones)
description: A model for viewing on a phone: in a mobile browser or AR. The strictest budget — we target inexpensive devices and mobile internet.

availableExtensions.title: Safe optimizations
availableExtensions.description: Lossless cleanup: dedup materials/textures, remove unused data, weld identical vertices, drop degenerate and orphan geometry. Shape and materials are not changed.
availableExtensions.impact: Smaller file with no visible change.

availableExtensions.title: Meshopt geometry compression
availableExtensions.description: Compresses geometry with Meshopt — smaller file that unpacks quickly on the GPU. A good default for the web.
availableExtensions.impact: Noticeably smaller geometry; fast decode in the browser.

availableExtensions.title: Join meshes
availableExtensions.description: Merges separate parts into one mesh — fewer draw calls. Structural: individual parts cannot be restored from the result.
availableExtensions.impact: Fewer draw calls; parts are merged (irreversible).

availableExtensions.title: KTX2 texture compression
availableExtensions.description: Converts textures to a GPU format: saves up to ~80% of video memory — spares the memory of budget phones. Requires KTX2Loader support in the browser.
availableExtensions.impact: The file may grow 5–10%, but texture video memory drops several-fold.

availableExtensions.title: Draco geometry compression
availableExtensions.description: Minimal file weight (often −50% on geometry) — faster loading over mobile internet. Decodes slower than Meshopt but is supported everywhere.
availableExtensions.impact: The file is noticeably lighter; decoding on open is slower.

availableExtensions.title: Remove vertex colors
availableExtensions.description: Removes painted vertex colors. Enable only if vertex colors are not visible in the model (white channels are removed without this option too).
availableExtensions.impact: Saves 5–20% of size if colors exist; may change the look if they were used.

notes: triangles 50000 — a conservative guideline for inexpensive smartphones; below the Khronos 3D Commerce recommendations for smoothness on a weak GPU.
drawCalls 30 — guideline: each draw call is costlier on a mobile GPU, so we keep them few.
textureMaxSize 1024 — a conservative guideline: 1K is enough for a phone screen and saves memory.
vramMB 48 — guideline: budget phones have little video memory.
fileMB 5 — guideline: fast loading over mobile internet.
noKtx true — v0.0.8: baseline plan without KTX2 (textures stay PNG/WebP); KTX2 is an extension enabled by explicit user choice.
texMode mixed — if the user enables the ktx2 extension: saving traffic and video memory matters more than maximum quality on a small screen.
extension id = core feature name: web-interface passes the selected ids to optimizeFile as advancedFeatures; the opts field is the equivalent for the legacy path.
